import matplotlib

import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({

    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,

})

PATTERN_COLORS = {
    'Benefit':    '#2e86ab',

    'Collapse':   '#c0392b',
    'V-recovery': '#e67e22',
}

pattern_markers = {
    'Benefit':    'o',
    'Immune':     's',
    'Collapse':   'v',

}

models = {
    'OLMo-2 7B':    (53.79, +3.21, 'Benefit'),

    'Gemma-2 9B':   (61.86, +3.76, 'Benefit'),

    'Qwen2.5-14B':  (69.44, -9.37, 'Collapse'),
}

# Cross-seed Δacc ranges (min, max) from per-seed eval results
cross_seed_ranges = {
    'OLMo-2 7B':    (-0.55, +3.21),
    'Falcon3 7B':   (+3.91, +4.19),
    'Gemma-2 9B':   (+1.49, +3.76),
    'Qwen2.5-7B':   (-1.78, -0.01),
    'Phi-4 14.7B':  (-0.17, +1.83),

}

label_offsets = {

    'Falcon3 7B':   (10, 4),
    'Gemma-2 9B':   (10, -3),
    'Qwen2.5-7B':   (10, 6),
    'Phi-4 14.7B':  (-12, 8),
    'Qwen2.5-14B':  (10, 5),
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 3.8))

# Background zones
ax.axhspan(0, 7, color='#2e86ab', alpha=0.04, zorder=0)
ax.axhspan(-27, 0, color='#c0392b', alpha=0.04, zorder=0)

# Zone labels
ax.text(51, 5.5, 'Benefit zone', fontsize=7.5, color='#2e86ab',
        alpha=0.5, fontstyle='italic', zorder=1)
ax.text(51, -11, 'Harm zone', fontsize=7.5, color='#c0392b',
        alpha=0.5, fontstyle='italic', zorder=1)

# Zero line
ax.axhline(y=0, color='#555555', linestyle='-', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.4, zorder=1)

# Threshold band
ax.axvspan(61.86, 66.11, color='#f0e68c', alpha=0.25, zorder=1)
ax.annotate('threshold\nregion', xy=(64.0, -11.5), fontsize=6.5,
            color='#8b7d3c', ha='center', fontstyle='italic', zorder=2)

# Error bars (cross-seed range)
ylim_lo, ylim_hi = -13, 7
for name, (x, y, pattern) in models.items():
    lo, hi = cross_seed_ranges[name]
    color = PATTERN_COLORS[pattern]
    clipped_lo = max(lo, ylim_lo + 0.3)
    ax.plot([x, x], [clipped_lo, hi], color=color, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, zorder=3)
    if lo < ylim_lo:
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x, ylim_lo + 0.15), xytext=(x, ylim_lo + 1.2),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.4),
                     zorder=3)
    else:
        ax.plot([x-0.4, x+0.4], [lo, lo], color=color, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3, zorder=3)
    ax.plot([x-0.4, x+0.4], [hi, hi], color=color, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3, zorder=3)

# Scatter points
for name, (x, y, pattern) in models.items():

    ax.scatter(x, y, c=color, marker=marker, s=140, zorder=5,

ax.set_xlabel('Baseline MMLU Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_ylabel('$\\Delta$acc @ d100 (pp)')
ax.set_xlim(50, 80)

]
ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right', fontsize=7.5,
          framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#dddddd', handletextpad=0.5,

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(out + '.png', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')

"""
Unified Figure Style Guide — ContamCal (EMNLP 2026)
====================================================
Import this module in every figure script for consistent styling.

Usage:
    from paper_style import apply_style, COLORS, MARKERS, figsize_column
    apply_style()
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize_column())
"""
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
import numpy as np

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. MASTER PALETTE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Design principles:
#   - Muted, desaturated tones (no tab10 / saturated web colors)
#   - Grayscale-distinguishable (luminance spread: 93 → 111 → 139 → 156)
#   - Colorblind-safe (blue–orange axis; no red-green reliance)
#   - Semantically coherent (warm = harm, cool = benefit, gray = neutral)

COLORS = {
    # --- 4-pattern semantic colors ---
    'Benefit':      '#3C7EA6',   # steel blue       (L≈111)
    'Immune':       '#8B8B8B',   # neutral gray      (L≈139)
    'Collapse':     '#A34232',   # muted brick       (L≈93)
    'V-recovery':   '#C49A3C',   # muted gold        (L≈156)

    # --- Benefit sub-variants (Fig 1 multi-model lines) ---
    'Benefit_primary':   '#3C7EA6',   # Gemma-2 (lead)
    'Benefit_secondary': '#6098BA',   # Falcon3 (lighter)
    'Benefit_tertiary':  '#2A5F82',   # OLMo-2 (darker, borderline)

    # --- Per-model mapping ---
    'Gemma-2 9B':     '#3C7EA6',
    'Falcon3 7B':     '#6098BA',
    'Falcon3-7B':     '#6098BA',
    'OLMo-2 7B':      '#2A5F82',
    'Phi-4 14.7B':    '#8B8B8B',
    'Phi-4 14B':      '#8B8B8B',
    'LLaMA-3.1 8B':   '#ABABAB',   # lighter gray (out-of-sample)
    'Qwen2.5-14B':    '#A34232',
    'Qwen2.5-7B':     '#C49A3C',

    # --- Benchmark colors (calibration/heatmap figures) ---
    'MMLU':          '#2D6A8E',   # deep teal
    'ARC':           '#5A8C6D',   # sage green
    'ARC-C':         '#5A8C6D',
    'GSM8K':         '#B07538',   # bronze

    # --- Sign-based domain coloring (domain γ_d plot) ---
    'positive_gamma': '#3C7EA6',   # same as Benefit (contamination helps)
    'negative_gamma': '#A34232',   # same as Collapse (contamination hurts)
    'pooled':         '#666666',   # neutral for pooled estimate

    # --- Auxiliary / UI ---
    'background':     '#FFFFFF',
    'grid':           '#E8E8E8',
    'axis':           '#333333',
    'text':           '#333333',
    'annotation':     '#555555',
    'reference':      '#AAAAAA',   # zero lines, reference lines
    'separator':      '#CCCCCC',   # group separators in forest plots
    'zone_benefit':   '#3C7EA6',   # for axhspan background tinting
    'zone_harm':      '#A34232',
    'zone_threshold': '#E8E0C8',   # threshold region fill (muted wheat)
    'significant':    '#2D6A4F',   # significance annotation (deep green)
    'nonsignificant': '#999999',
}

# Opacity presets
ALPHA = {
    'ci_band':        0.12,    # confidence interval shading
    'zone':           0.05,    # background zone tinting
    'grid':           0.15,    # grid lines
    'reference_line': 0.40,    # zero / reference lines
    'error_bar':      0.30,    # cross-seed range bars
    'zone_label':     0.45,    # "Benefit zone" / "Harm zone" text
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. MARKERS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
MARKERS = {
    # Per-pattern
    'Benefit':      'o',
    'Immune':       's',
    'Collapse':     'v',
    'V-recovery':   'D',

    # Per-model (for dose-response curves)
    'Gemma-2 9B':     's',   # square
    'Falcon3 7B':     '^',   # triangle up
    'Falcon3-7B':     '^',
    'OLMo-2 7B':      'o',   # circle
    'Phi-4 14.7B':    'D',   # diamond
    'Phi-4 14B':      'D',
    'LLaMA-3.1 8B':   'p',   # pentagon
    'Qwen2.5-14B':    'v',   # triangle down
    'Qwen2.5-7B':     '<',   # triangle left
